messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: service=dedicated-inference-prod check=error-rate-high fired (policy=pg-critical). Incident PD-9007.
pagerduty-bot: Primary on-call Ana Rivera notified. Escalation in 2m to secondary if not acknowledged. Manager notify will fire after additional 4m.
Ana Rivera: Acked. On it. Saw an uptick in 502/504s across the dedicated cluster. Kicking off quick triage.
Samir Das: Support ping: customers A and B seeing long tails on streaming responses, timeouts at ~30s. Noticed logs with connection reset by peer.
Ana Rivera: Good context. Starting capture of svc logs and tcpdump on a sample host. Creating bridge link: https://zoom.company/incident/9007
Lina Ortega: I'm jumping on the bridge. Observability shows most errors coming from nodepool flavor d-gpu-2. I'm going to check kernel logs and driver messages.
incident-bot: PD escalation: secondary Samir Das auto-notified (no ack within 2m).
Samir Das: Sorry, was in meeting. Acked now and joining. I can take lead if Ana needs to hand off.
OpsWatch: Alert summary: error_rate=7.8% (baseline 0.2%), latency_p95=1.8s -> 4.6s, affected_hosts=6/48.
Chris Howard: Quick note: I saw a recent rollout of runtime v2.3 to d-gpu-2 earlier this morning. Any correlation?
Ana Rivera: Hmm, that could explain. Looking at rollout tags: batch update id=rollout-2026-03-15-07. Rolling back? Need more data.
Lina Ortega: Kernel logs from host d-gpu-7: `Mar 15 07:11:22 hostkernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, GPU has fallen off the bus.` That matches crash/recover cycles.
Samir Das: Replacing affected nodes from pool. Command: `infractl node recycle --pool d-gpu-2 --filter 'uptime<2h'`
incident-bot: Note: manager notify armed to fire in 4m if incident remains unacked/unresolved.
Ana Rivera: Rolling back runtime on a small subset of hosts to v2.2 and watching.
Chris Howard: Rollback started on 3 hosts. Adding a temporary routing rule to avoid d-gpu-2 hosts: `routerctl route set service dedicated-inference-prod avoid_pool=d-gpu-2`
Lina Ortega: After rollback and routing changes, error_rate down to 1.1% in 45s. Still watching for residual spikes.
Samir Das: Host d-gpu-7 shows repeated GPU driver resets. Opening ticket to NV driver team to investigate hardware/firmware.
Ana Rivera: Noting customer comms: support posted to affected customers that we are mitigating and ETA ~10m.
incident-bot: PD event: manager notify fired to Chris Howard due to escalation policy (PD-9007).
Chris Howard: I'm on notify. If you want me on bridge, @Ana ping.
Lina Ortega: Suggest adding extra health-check frequency for driver resets and a kill-switch to stop traffic to node on first GPU Xid 31 event. Filing runbook task.
Samir Das: New hosts spun up and warmed. Traffic rerouted. Error rate stable ~0.3% for last 2m.
Ana Rivera: Looks stable. We'll keep in monitoring for 20m. If no regressions, we will resume standard routing and close incident. Action items: (1) add driver-event detector and auto-evacuate nodes, (2) rollback criteria update for runtime rollouts, (3) contact NV driver team for long term fix.
Chris Howard: I'll own rollback criteria update. Samir, can you own the driver detector?
Samir Das: Yep. Creating tasks now and linking to PD-9007.
incident-bot: PD incident PD-9007 status: acknowledged -> mitigation underway -> monitoring.
Ana Rivera: Exiting #incidents channel, leaving follow-ups to owners. Great response, folks. :clap:
OpsWatch: Final note: incident resolved state will be set after 20m stable window.
pagerduty-bot: PD update: Incident PD-9007 will auto-resolve after monitoring threshold met or manual resolve by on-call.
